answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can bid on work, released only after a year of clean history. One honest agent treats the bond like a jade heirloom it gets back; a sybil army must stake a fresh relic for every clone, and when a falcon-eyed auditor catches one copy cheating, the slashing spreads to every bond funded from the same source, so faking scale costs real money.
